DSSP-RAG is evaluated on five datasets, including two single-hop QA datasets: Natural Questions (NQ) which is based on real user queries, and TriviaQA that consists of trivia questions; and two multi-hop QA datasets: Adversarial HotpotQA , and 2WikiMultihopQA , which assess cross-document reasoning and information integration using Wikipedia data. In ad-dition, PubHealth (Kotonya and Toni, 2020) is a closed-set generative dataset that comprises medical claims on various biomedical topics.
